posts.text: What is happening here folks? The company has been cancelling “meetings and publishing of results” on one pretext or the other(I must say, ruthlessly, without even thinking of the impact on the investor or the stock price). I was betting on Zee to have come in(at ~213 Rs. or something) and then recently, the promoter has also exercised his warrants(Though a small amount of ~9.88 Cr. but, interestingly with an issue price of 247 Rs.). Curious to know thoughts. If they have a genuine “company merger complications” that are leading to un-publishing of results(which actually sounds so contrived),…
